sections.heading: Powerful Features Out of the Box
sections.subHeading: AG Charts comes packed with features to help you build beautiful, interactive charts with minimal effort.

features.heading: Series & Data
features.detail: Multiple series types with flexible data binding using key properties.

features.heading: Axis Types
features.detail: Categorical, numerical, time, and logarithmic axes with full customisation.

features.heading: Secondary Axes
features.detail: Multiple axes per direction for comparing series with different scales.

features.heading: Legends
features.detail: Configurable legends with positioning, pagination, and series toggling.

features.heading: Cross Lines
features.detail: Add reference lines and ranges to highlight important values.

features.heading: Conditional Styling
features.detail: Item stylers for dynamic appearance based on data values.

features.heading: Themes
features.detail: 5 built-in themes with light and dark modes, plus custom theming.

features.heading: Fills & Strokes
features.detail: Solid colours, gradients, patterns, and images for series styling.

features.heading: Markers
features.detail: Customisable marker shapes, sizes, and styles for data points.

features.heading: Tooltips
features.detail: Rich tooltips with multiple modes and custom renderers.

features.heading: Highlighting
features.detail: Hover highlighting with customisable styles for items and series.

features.heading: Events
features.detail: Click, double-click, and zoom events for series, legend, and chart.

features.heading: Zoom & Pan
features.detail: Interactive zoom and pan controls for exploring large datasets.

features.heading: Context Menu
features.detail: Right-click menus with customisable actions and download options.

features.heading: Navigator
features.detail: Mini-chart navigator for quick navigation through time-series data.

items.question: Is AG Charts free to use?
items.answer: Yes! AG Charts Community is free and open-source, with no restrictions on usage. [AG Charts Enterprise](/license-pricing/) offers additional features like financial charts, annotations, and advanced interactivity.

items.question: What chart types does AG Charts support?
items.answer: AG Charts supports 30+ chart types including Bar, Line, Area, Scatter, Pie, Donut, Radar, Treemap, Sunburst, Heatmap, Candlestick, Maps, Gauges, and many more. View all chart types in our [Gallery](/gallery/).

items.question: Can I use AG Charts with TypeScript?
items.answer: Yes! AG Charts is written in TypeScript and provides full type definitions. Our Angular integration works seamlessly with Angular's strict type checking.

items.question: How do I get started with AG Charts in Angular?
items.answer: Install the package with `npm install ag-charts-angular ag-charts-community`, import the `AgCharts` component, and use it in your template. See our [Quick Start guide](./angular/quick-start/) for a complete walkthrough.

items.question: What Angular versions are supported?
items.answer: AG Charts supports Angular 16 and later, including standalone components. We test against the latest Angular versions and maintain backwards compatibility.

items.question: What is AG Charts Enterprise?
items.answer: [AG Charts Enterprise](/license-pricing/) includes advanced features like Financial Charts with annotations, Maps, Gauges, Zoom, Crosshairs, and more. Try it free with a trial license.

items.question: Can AG Charts handle large datasets?
items.answer: Yes! AG Charts is optimized for performance and can handle millions of data points smoothly. Our canvas-based rendering ensures fast updates and smooth interactions.

items.question: Is AG Charts compatible with AG Grid?
items.answer: Yes! AG Charts integrates seamlessly with [AG Grid](https://www.ag-grid.com/) for Integrated Charts, allowing users to create charts directly from grid data.
